parameters.help_en: The type-specific configurations. Optional prompts for ExperienceMining and SkillOptimize only support inline Markdown. The main text is saved to inputs.prompt.content (non-empty UTF-8, up to 16 KiB)

parameters.name: optimize_task_name

parameters.help_en: The status of the task. Valid values: Enabled, Disabled
parameters.name: status
